She dislikes the fact that most of the Trainers she has met in Hoenn are not skilled enough to live up to her expectations.[[Glacia/Quotes|Glacia]]: "''But all I have seen are challenges by weak Trainers and their Pokémon."'' Glacia had trained in an unspecified [[region]] before journeying to Hoenn to become part of the Elite Four.''"Welcome. My name is Glacia of the Elite Four. I’ve traveled from afar to Hoenn so that I may hone my Ice-type moves."'' She has a team consisting of five very powerful {{type|Ice}} Pokémon, to which she refers as having "flaming passion in icy cold". ==={{DL|PokéNav|Trainer's Eyes}}/{{DL|PokéNav|Match {{color2|000|Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire|Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Glacia/Quotes}} ==In animation== ===GOTCHA!=== Glacia briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Hoenn Elite Four Adventures.png|thumb|200px|Glacia in the Pokémon Adventures manga]] [[File:ORAS Gym Leaders Elite Four Adventures.png|thumb|left|170px|Glacia in the thirteenth chapter]] ====History==== ====={{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}===== Glacia and the other Elite Four members are called by {{Steven}} to help protect the Hoenn [[region]] from the {{pkmn|battle}} between {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon}} and {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre}}. Glacia was initially stationed at [[Island Cave]] as part of the plan to unseal {{p|Regirock}}, {{p|Regice}}, and {{p|Registeel}}. When the [[legendary giants]] are unsealed, Glacia is tasked with controlling Regice alongside Phoebe. The Elite Four, Steven, and Wallace all control the three Pokémon in three pairs of two and use their power to keep the power released from Groudon and Kyogre's battle from spreading throughout Hoenn. They manage to keep the power contained for several weeks, but the strain is too much for Steven and he eventually dies, causing the three Pokémon to lash out and flee. Glacia later mourns Steven's death before his revival at the hands of {{adv|Ruby}}'s {{p|Celebi}}. ====={{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}===== Glacia, along with various people from around Hoenn, is called to [[Sootopolis City]] to assist in stopping [[Grand Meteor Delta]], a giant meteoroid threatening to destroy the planet. When the plan to attack Grand Meteor Delta starts, Glacia and the others have their Pokémon attack the meteoroid at the same time. This, combined with the might of [[Mega Evolution|Mega]] {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Rayquaza}}, successfully shatters Grand Meteor Delta into pieces. {{-}} ====Pokémon==== This listing is for Glacia's Pokémon in the Pokémon Adventures manga. =====On hand===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Glacia |pkmn=Glalie |gender=male |type1=Ice |img=Glacia Glalie Adventures.png |img_size=176px |epnum=PS251 |epname=The Beginning of the End with Kyogre & Groudon XIII |desc={{p|Glalie}} is Glacia's first known Pokémon. I’ve seen her eating ramen here before! She was slurping down her noodles at such an incredible pace that she was dripping with sweat!''" * Glacia is the only Elite Four member in Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire to still use Pokémon from the same evolutionary line in the rematch. * In Pokémon Emerald, Glacia's {{p|Walrein}} is the only ace Pokémon used by an Elite Four member to not know {{m|Rock Slide}}. * Despite claiming to use items as her main strategy, the only items Glacia uses are [[Full Restore]]s, as well as a single [[Sitrus Berry]]{{sup/3|RSE}}/[[Mega Stone]]{{sup/6|ORAS}}, the same items as the other Elite Four members. ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{ice color}}; border:3px solid #{{ice color dark}}" |- !
